d: Global conflicts are triggering a growing “4F crisis” across food, fuel, fertiliser and finance, with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar warning of rising costs and supply chain disruptions. Firstpost examines how energy price spikes, shipping disruptions and extreme weather are worsening food inflation and financial pressures on import-dependent economies, alongside calls for international cooperation and resilient supply chains.
